title: SANNAHED frame
description: SANNAHED frame, birch effect, 9 ¾x9 ¾" Decorate with pictures you love. SANNAHED creates nice shadows and you can place the motif in the front or back of the deep frame. The plastic front protection is safe – and does justice to the motif. The mat enhances the picture and makes framing easy.
features: This frame fits with a picture that has dimensions 5⅛x5⅛" if you use it with the mat, and it fits with a picture that has dimensions 9⅞x9⅞" if you choose to use the frame without the mat.
The mat will not turn yellow since it is acid-free.
Screws for wall mounting not included. recommends using ALFTA adhesive hook. Sold separately.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
materialAndCare: Mat: Paper; Frame/ Inside frame: Fiberboard, Paper foil; Front protection: Polystyrene
